//WatchPaths: ADR-0042: WatchPaths is now a BOOTSTRAP discovery source only. Each entry seeds a record in <TaskRepository>/.metadata/projects.json on first boot if no record yet points at the same RootPath. Once a record exists, the registry is the source of truth: removing an entry from this list does NOT delete its project record, and renaming an entry's Name does NOT rename the registry's DisplayName. Real entries are configured in the gitignored appsettings.Local.json; see appsettings.Local.json.example.
//GitRetention: Host-owned startup and recurring maintenance. RetentionDays uses the tip commit time. Only task/* and runner/* refs contained in both develop and main are eligible; checked-out or changed refs are retained. IntervalHours is clamped to 1..168.
//Watcher: AGT-2721 global Watcher (docs/operations/orchestrator-waechter/). Enabled is the kill switch and is OFF by default: switching it on lets the sweep write ticket proposals into 1-preparation with the watcher-proposal tag. It never moves a card to Ready and never touches Git. IntervalSeconds is the dossier's reconciliation cadence (300 = five minutes). AnalysisEnabled gates model calls; analysis runs only for a case that declared an uncertain cause and only inside the contingent. AnalysisTier must name a tier of docs/system/domains/model-routing-policy.md; sol-medium is the dossier's strong-analysis floor and quota or price may not lower it. ProposalProject names the project that receives proposals for workspace-wide cases; without it the first watch path is used and the fallback is logged. Contingent is the dedicated per-day and per-week budget: set every value to 0 to keep detecting and counting while stopping every model call and every proposal.
//PostProcessing: Auto-review post-processing worker. The concurrent-card cap is DERIVED from machine capacity (cores/2, clamped 3..12 - see AutoReviewPostProcessingWorker.DeriveMaxParallelism); a fixed override here previously pinned it to 3 and starved whole projects out of the queue. Set PostProcessing:MaxParallelism only to consciously override the derivation.
//WorkspaceEvidence: Transition-Committer: continuously commit workspace evidence in the TaskRepository git repo after lane transitions (only that repo is ever committed into; watch paths resolving to a foreign git root are dropped). Enabled (default true) turns it on; DebounceSeconds is the quiet window before a repo's batch commits; MaxDelaySeconds caps how long an actively-churning repo defers; Push (default false) pushes each evidence commit via the existing workspace push queue. Allow-list scoping stages only touched projects/<name> folders, so repo-ROOT runtime noise (identities/, telemetry/, logs/) is already out; ExcludeGlobs additionally drop runtime/scratch that lives INSIDE a project folder - notably */.orchestrator/* (tracked, high-churn session state that scoping cannot exclude). Globs are applied as git :(exclude) pathspecs so they hold for already-tracked files. IndexLockRetry* govern the .git/index.lock retry shared with the punctual job-folder commits.
